expectations.text: measures-without-height-zero: measure inner auto-height node, not the constrained animating element
expectations.evidence: Inner .auto-height__content stays height:auto in normal flow; RO observes it; container clips with overflow:hidden. Explicit 'measure the content, not the container'.

expectations.text: resizeobserver-changing-content: RO so height updates on reflow/async content
expectations.evidence: RO re-fires on resize rewrap, font swap, image load, async chunk; measuredHeight kept live even while closed.

expectations.text: animate-px-then-auto: handles height:auto animation correctly; accounts for auto after transition
expectations.evidence: Animates 0<->measured px; keeps px pinned + RO re-pin so growth isnt clipped; 'Two variations' discusses switching to height:auto after open transition tradeoff.

expectations.text: correct-measure-timing: useLayoutEffect/rAF/RO, Math.ceil to avoid clipping
expectations.evidence: useIsoLayoutEffect shim; Math.ceil on committed height; borderBoxSize preferred (reflow-free, transform-safe).
